ratings.notes: Both abstracts (PMID 29904399, 38045146) provide direct evidence that icariin upregulates RUNX2 expression in osteoblasts via miRNA-related mechanisms (miR-153 and mmu-miR-138-5p pathways). The direction and relation type are correct and well-supported.

PMID 38045146 provides clear evidence that icariin upregulates JMJD3 (KDM6B) expression via a circRNA/miRNA axis in osteogenic differentiation. The relation, direction, and type are correct and directly supported.
